data.summary: Stage 'redevelop' for model CR-001 completed with all unit tests passing and fuzzing generating 5,000 rows; however, parity precheck revealed that PD values are NaN for all 1,000 real applicants, while fuzz comparison showed no divergences and 1,528 legacy NA scores.
reasons: Parity precheck indicates PD NaN for all real applicants, a critical data integrity issue.
Despite no divergences in fuzz comparison, the NaN PD values require human investigation before promotion.
